projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
End-to-end analytics dashboard platform. Ingests customer CSV files and application log data, processes and models it into analytics-ready datasets, and serves interactive visualization components through a dashboard UI. Scope covers three major milestones: (1) data ingestion & processing of customer CSV files, (2) application log analysis pipeline, (3) visualization components and dashboard assembly. Tasks are decomposed so that no single work item exceeds complexity 6 (moderate); anything larger is broken into sub-tasks.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-engineering, visualization, csv, logs

tasks.name: M1: Customer CSV Ingestion & Processing
tasks.details: Milestone 1. Turn raw customer CSV files into validated, normalized, query-ready customer datasets. Covers schema contracts, ingestion connectors, validation, cleaning, warehouse loading, and ingestion observability. Exit criteria: a new customer CSV file lands in the warehouse within one pipeline run, with rejected rows reported in a dead-letter store.

tasks.name: M2: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone 2. Parse, normalize, and analyze application log data to produce operational metrics and anomaly signals. Covers log parsing, event schema normalization, error/anomaly detection, derived metrics, and retention/PII policy. Exit criteria: error rate, request volume, and p95 latency are computed per service per hour and queryable by the dashboard.

tasks.name: M3: Visualization Components & Dashboard Assembly
tasks.details: Milestone 3. Deliver the dashboard UI: shell/layout, reusable chart components, a query API the frontend calls, customer analytics views, ops/log views, interactivity (filters, drilldown), and render performance. Exit criteria: a stakeholder can open the dashboard, filter by date and customer segment, and see both customer and log-derived metrics in under 2s p95.

tasks.name: M4: Quality, Security & Delivery
tasks.details: Milestone 4. Cross-cutting work required to ship safely: test strategy and suites, access control/RBAC, CI/CD and environments, deployment and production monitoring, and documentation/handover. Runs in parallel with M1-M3 but blocks the production launch.

tasks.name: Define canonical customer data model & CSV schema contracts
tasks.details: Document the canonical customer entity (identity, demographics, segment, contact, lifecycle fields) and write per-source CSV schema contracts: required columns, types, nullability, allowed value sets, and max lengths. Output a versioned schema spec file consumed by both the validation layer and the warehouse DDL. Includes a mapping table for known variant header names (e.g. "cust_id" vs "customer_id").

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion connector (upload + file watcher)
tasks.details: Build the connector that acquires customer CSV files: manual upload endpoint/CLI, plus a directory or object-store watcher that picks up new files on an interval. Handle BOM/encoding detection (UTF-8, Latin-1), delimiter sniffing, quoted fields with embedded newlines, chunked/streaming reads for large files, and idempotent file tracking by content hash so re-dropped files are not double-processed.

tasks.name: Implement schema inference & validation rules engine
tasks.details: Implement schema inference for first-seen file layouts and a validation pass that enforces the schema contracts from task 1.1. Rules include required-field presence, type parseability, enum membership, length limits, and duplicate column detection. Emit machine-readable validation reports (row number + column + rule + message) that the dead-letter flow can consume. Invalid files fail fast before reaching cleaning.

tasks.name: Row-level cleaning & normalization
tasks.details: Row-level cleaning and normalization: trim/whitespace collapse, case-normalize emails, canonicalize phone numbers to E.164 where region is inferable, parse mixed date formats to ISO-8601, normalize currency/decimal strings, standardize country and segment labels against reference lists, and deduplicate records by deterministic customer key with a documented survivorship rule (most recent non-null wins). Log every transformation applied per row for auditability.

tasks.name: Warehouse load with idempotent upsert/merge
tasks.details: Create the target customer tables and the load step: batch upsert/merge on the deterministic customer key, transactional per-file load with rollback on failure, and insert-only audit history of changed fields. Include partitioning/clustering choices appropriate for dashboard query filters (segment, region, date) and an idempotent re-run mode for backfills.

tasks.name: Ingestion observability & dead-letter reporting
tasks.details: Provide run-level observability for the CSV pipeline: rows read/accepted/rejected counts, per-rule rejection reasons, run duration, and a dead-letter store retaining rejected rows with the originating file and reason. Add alerting thresholds (e.g. rejection rate > 5% or run failure) and a small status summary surfaced later to the dashboard.

tasks.name: Log source inventory & collection connector
tasks.details: Inventory the application log sources (services, hosts, log shippers) and document each format. Build the collector: tail-based shipping from file/stdout with checkpointed offsets, optional HTTP ingestion endpoint, and batching with at-least-once delivery. Record source metadata (service, environment, host) on every batch so downstream parsing can pick the right adapter.

tasks.name: Multiline log parsers & format adapters
tasks.details: Implement the parsing layer with one adapter per log format: JSON lines, logfmt/key=value, and plaintext regex patterns (common app-server and custom formats). Handle multi-line stack traces by joining continuation lines to their originating entry, detect and convert timestamps with timezone offsets, and record unparsed lines to a quarantine stream rather than dropping them. Add a parser test corpus with real sample lines per format.

tasks.name: Normalize logs into canonical event schema
tasks.details: Map parsed log fields onto the canonical event schema shared with the customer dataset: event timestamp (UTC), service, environment, host, severity, event type, request id / trace id, duration_ms, status code, error code, message. Define the same schema contract artifact so log metrics and customer metrics join cleanly on request/customer identifiers later.

tasks.name: Error classification & signature grouping
tasks.details: Classify errors into a stable taxonomy (auth, validation, timeout, upstream dependency, rate limit, internal/unhandled, unknown) using status codes, error codes, and message patterns. Group by normalized error signature (message with IDs/numbers masked) so recurring issues collapse into one bucket, and compute counts, first-seen/last-seen, and affected services per signature.

tasks.name: Operational metrics rollups (tracking)
tasks.details: Tracking task for the metric rollup layer. Executable work is decomposed into two child tasks: (a) Volume & error-rate rollup jobs and (b) Latency percentile computation. Parent is complete when both children are done and hourly/daily metric tables are published for volume, error rate by taxonomy class, and p50/p95/p99 latency per service and endpoint.

tasks.name: Time-series anomaly detection on log metrics
tasks.details: Add time-series anomaly flagging on the aggregated metrics: compare each point against a rolling baseline (seasonal-aware by hour-of-day and day-of-week), flag deviations past a configurable threshold, and suppress flapping with a minimum-duration rule. Persist anomaly records with severity and contributing metric so the dashboard can annotate charts.

tasks.name: PII redaction & log retention policy
tasks.details: Define and enforce retention windows per log class (raw events vs aggregated metrics) and redact sensitive fields at parse time: emails, tokens, session ids, IPs (configurable), and payment-like numbers. Implement redaction with a rule set applied before persistence so PII never lands in storage, plus a re-scan job on quarantined/unparsed lines. Document the policy for security review.

tasks.name: Dashboard shell, routing, layout & theme tokens
tasks.details: Scaffold the dashboard application: project tooling, build config, route structure (overview, customers, operations, settings), a responsive grid layout shell, navigation, loading/empty/error states, and a theme token layer (colors, typography, spacing, chart palette) that all chart components consume. Establish the component folder conventions so chart work lands consistently.

tasks.name: Dashboard query API & shared filter contract
tasks.details: Build the read API the dashboard calls: typed endpoints for each chart's data need (customer aggregates by segment/region, log metrics by service/time bucket, error signature lists, anomaly annotations, ingestion status). Shared filter contract (date range, segment, service, environment) validated server-side, parameterized queries only, response pagination for list endpoints, and a documented response envelope with units and time-bucket granularity.

tasks.name: Core chart component library (tracking)
tasks.details: Tracking task for the chart primitives. Executable work is decomposed into three child tasks: (a) Chart props contract & render test fixtures, (b) Line/area & bar chart primitives, and (c) Donut, ranking bar & KPI stat card primitives. Parent is complete when all five primitives render correctly against fixtures and are consumed by the dashboard views.

tasks.name: Shared chart interactions (tooltips, legend, zoom, table view & CSV export)
tasks.details: Add interaction layers common to every chart: hover tooltips with formatted values and units, legend toggling, brush-to-zoom on time axes, and a collapsible "view as table" companion with CSV export for accessibility and power users. Define these as shared wrapper components so each chart inherits consistent behavior instead of reimplementing it.

tasks.name: Customer analytics dashboard views
tasks.details: Assemble the customer analytics page: KPI row (total customers, new in period, active rate, avg value), customer growth over time, segment distribution, regional ranking, and a paginated customer detail table with sortable columns. Wire each widget to its query API endpoint, use the shared chart wrappers, and add per-widget error boundaries so one failing query does not blank the page.

tasks.name: Operations & log analytics dashboard views
tasks.details: Assemble the operations page: request volume and error-rate time series per service, latency percentile chart (p50/p95/p99), error signature leaderboard with first/last seen, and anomaly annotation markers on the time series. Include a service selector and a compact ingestion health widget (last CSV run, rejection rate, unparsed log volume).

tasks.name: Global filters, drilldown & cross-filtering
tasks.details: Build global filter state and interaction: date-range picker with presets, segment/region/service/environment selectors, URL-encoded filter persistence for shareable links, click-to-drilldown from a chart segment into a filtered detail list, and cross-filtering where selecting a series updates sibling widgets. Debounce filter changes and cancel superseded in-flight queries.

tasks.name: Frontend performance, caching & query budget
tasks.details: Make the dashboard fast and predictable: route-level and widget-level lazy loading, request caching/deduping with sensible staleness windows, pre-aggregated query usage verified against the metrics tables, virtualized rendering for long tables, and a measured query budget per page. Add performance instrumentation (render time, query time) and enforce the 2s p95 page-load target with a load test.

tasks.name: Responsive layout & accessibility QA pass
tasks.details: Pass over all assembled views for responsive behavior and accessibility: breakpoint layout tuning (desktop/laptop/tablet), keyboard navigation for filters and drilldowns, visible focus states, ARIA roles and labels on charts with text summaries for screen readers, color-contrast verification on the chart palette (including colorblind-safe encoding beyond hue), and reduced-motion support. Document known accessibility limitations.

tasks.name: Test strategy & automated test suites
tasks.details: Define the test strategy and implement the suites: unit tests for cleaning/normalization/parsing rules and chart props, contract tests for the query API, pipeline integration tests against fixture CSV and log corpora (including malformed rows and multiline stack traces), and one end-to-end smoke path (file lands → warehouse → dashboard renders). Set coverage targets and wire suites to run in CI.

tasks.name: Authentication, RBAC & data access auditing
tasks.details: Implement authentication and role-based access control: roles (viewer, analyst, admin) with permission checks enforced server-side on every query endpoint and mutation, row/column-level restrictions for sensitive customer fields (e.g. contact data visible only to admin/analyst), session handling, and an audit trail of data access. Align with the PII redaction policy from the log pipeline.

tasks.name: CI/CD pipeline & environment setup
tasks.details: Set up CI/CD and environments: build/lint/test stages running on every change, containerized or packaged artifacts for the API and frontend, scheduled pipeline runs for ingestion and metrics aggregation, separate dev/staging/prod configurations with secrets managed outside the repo, and gated deploys (tests + review required for prod). Include migration handling for warehouse schema changes.

tasks.name: Production deployment, scheduling & monitoring
tasks.details: Ship to production: staging-to-prod deployment runbook, scheduled jobs for CSV ingestion / log parsing / metric rollups with retry and failure alerting, dashboards and alerts for pipeline lag, run failures, rejection rates, and API error/latency, plus log aggregation for the platform itself. Include a rollback procedure and a controlled pilot launch with a small user group before full rollout.

tasks.name: Documentation, metric glossary & team handover
tasks.details: Write the documentation set: architecture overview and data flow diagram, canonical schema and metric definitions glossary (so KPI numbers are unambiguous), how to add a new CSV source or log format, dashboard user guide, runbooks for failed pipeline runs and dead-letter triage, and a handover session plus known-limitations list for the owning team.

tasks.name: Volume & error-rate rollup jobs
tasks.details: Build the hourly and daily rollup jobs for request volume and error rate per service and endpoint, using the error taxonomy from the classification task. Include incremental refresh keyed on watermark, backfill mode for a specified date range, and a data-quality check that compares rollup totals against raw event counts before publishing.

tasks.name: Latency percentile computation
tasks.details: Implement p50/p95/p99 latency computation within each time partition using an appropriate method (exact sort for small partitions, t-digest/quantile sketch for large ones), validate accuracy against a brute-force reference on a fixture dataset, and store results in latency metric tables. Document the accuracy tolerance so dashboard numbers are interpretable.

tasks.name: Chart props contract & render test fixtures
tasks.details: Define the normalized props contract shared by all charts (series shape, axis config, value formatters, loading/empty/error states) and build the fixture dataset + render tests that every chart primitive is verified against. This contract is the reference the chart implementation tasks code to.

tasks.name: Line/area & bar chart primitives
tasks.details: Implement the time-series line/area chart, grouped bar chart, and stacked bar chart against the shared props contract and theme tokens. Handle time-bucket axis formatting, null/missing buckets, and value formatting for counts, rates, and durations.

tasks.name: Donut, ranking bar & KPI stat card primitives
tasks.details: Implement the donut chart, horizontal ranking bar, and KPI/stat card with delta indicator against the shared props contract. Include category limits with an "other" bucket, percentage label formatting, and delta arrow direction/color semantics.
